text: Upon applying for the IDR ( SAVE ) plan, I was informed that my estimated payment will be somewhere around {$250.00} a month give or take. Some time towards the end of XXXX almost XXXX I logged into my Mohela account t and saw my total due amount jump to $ XXXX. I decided to submit a new IDR application just incase there was an issue. I then contacted Mohela to find out why my amount increased almost by 100 % and they were unable to explain why. They did however place my account into forbearance while they reviewed my recently submitted application to adjust the amount. This took place in XX/XX/2023. Somehow after resubmitting the application my new balance due post forbearance has gone up to $ XXXX. I have included my application submitted XX/XX/2023 for reference along with a screenshot of my current balance as of XX/XX/2023.
